I was really looking forward to these. I bought two as gifts for two close friends of mine. Both are very into skin care but only had about two and a half weeks to use them. Within that time period, both beauty fridges have stopped becoming cold. We used different outlets, unplugged and turned off, etc. nothing has worked. Very disappointed.

reviews.t: Cute and functional, but a little loud and always a puddle in the bottom
reviews.x: I store my beauty products in this cute fridge in the bathroom. Luckily it’s not near my bed or the fan noise would probably bother me. It’s not super loud, but you can definitely hear it running. The bottom shelf also has a perpetual puddle of water on the back right side. I have cleaned it up more than once wondering if it was condensation from a jar but it just keeps coming back. So I don’t know how long the fridge will ultimately last, but it is cute and does keep products cold!

claims.text: Many reviewers report the unit stopped working or failed to cool within days to a few weeks of use.
Reviewers frequently describe the fridge as cute and pretty, often using it for skincare or at a desk.
Several reviewers say it cools well and holds a good amount of skincare products.
A few reviewers mention noise or water pooling in the bottom.
Some reviewers note limited space or temperature that is only okay rather than very cold.

qa.q: Does it actually get cold enough to keep my makeup cool?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it keeps products very cold or holds steady at 40 degrees [5][6], while others report it stopped getting cold within weeks [1][2] and one says it's usually not really cold but an okay temperature [3].

claims.text: It keeps skincare products very cold.
It holds steady right at 40 degrees.
It stopped becoming cold within about two and a half weeks.
It stopped working and products are no longer cold.
It is usually not really cold, just an okay temperature for skincare products.

qa.q: How long does it stay cool after unplugging?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it quiet enough to keep on my vanity?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on noise: some say it's quiet enough to barely tell it's on [4], while others describe it as loud, like a fan running full blast [1][2].

claims.text: One reviewer says it's super quiet and they could barely tell if it was even on [4].
Other reviewers describe it as loud, with one saying you can definitely hear it running and another comparing it to a large fan running full blast [1][2].

qa.q: Will it fit my skincare bottles and makeup brushes?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate it fits skincare bottles and serums, but makeup brushes are not mentioned. One reviewer fit multiple bottles, serums, and creams [1], and another says it holds all their facial serums and lotions [3], though one notes it is smaller than expected [5].

claims.text: One reviewer fit all their face masks, two mini serums, a cream, eye roller, and three small bottles
Another reviewer says it holds all of their facial serums and lotions
One reviewer notes it is smaller than they thought

qa.q: Does it leak or build up condensation on my counter?
qa.answer: Yes, several reviews report water buildup: one notes a perpetual puddle on the bottom shelf [1], another says it drips inside and gets everything wet [2], and a third notes it can leak [3]. However, other reviews report no such problems [4][5].

claims.text: One review reports a perpetual puddle of water on the bottom shelf [1].
Another review says it drips water from the inside and gets everything wet [2].
A third review notes it can leak [3].
